## Writing Advice

Here, I give some general advice about writing papers. Many folks have written good advice: I highly recommend Barry Weingast's, which can be found [here](http://www.stanford.edu/~weingast/caltech_rules.html). Also see [Chris Blattman](http://chrisblattman.com/2010/02/17/how-to-write-an-essay/) and [Henry Farrell](http://themonkeycage.org/blog/2010/02/16/good_writing_in_political_scie/).

**[Download my writing advice (PDF)](files/paper_advice.pdf)**
